ledger: Diner exterior (00:00): Shows the front facade with a glass door on the left and large windows. Through the windows, the counter and stools are visible running parallel to the front wall.
Diner interior (00:10, 00:19): Shows the counter running perpendicular to the front wall (where the main entrance is located in the background).
Pass-through window (00:45): Connects kitchen to the main dining area, consistent with the interior layout established at 00:19.
Traversals: Man enters through front door (00:19), walks to truck outside (01:41) - consistent with the interior floor plan.

findings.description: The exterior establishing shot at 00:00 clearly shows the diner's counter and stools arranged parallel to the front windowed wall. However, the interior shots starting at 00:19 depict the counter running perpendicular to the front wall containing the main entrance door.
